Looking for the best health insurance plan in India? In this video, we review the Aditya Birla Activ One Max Health Insurance Plan, a feature-packed policy that goes beyond traditional medical insurance.

👉 Key Highlights of Aditya Birla Activ One Max Plan
✔ Unlimited Hospitalization (Super Reload): Sum insured refills even after multiple claims.
 ✔ Wide Coverage: Available as both individual & family floater, covering up to 2 adults + 4 children or extended family in individual format.
 ✔ 6X Cover by 6th Year: Base sum insured doubles every year up to 6 times.
 ✔ Claim Protect: Covers non-medical costs like gloves, syringes, cotton, etc.
 ✔ HealthReturns Program: Earn up to 100% premium back for maintaining a healthy lifestyle.
 ✔ Cashless Treatment: Access to 4800+ network hospitals across India.
The plan is flexible with policy terms of 1–3 years and sum insured options from ₹2 lakh to ₹6 crore.
